description: OV-1001 numeric budgets, set from the Linux x64 pre-change baseline logs/agent-context-5IGIXx (commit 935771e4) before the fixes were accepted. Byte and token budgets are the larger cold/warm baseline value plus 5% for run-specific environment text (git warm-up state, MCP catalog timing); request, duplicate and tool-history budgets are exact. Token counts are estimates. Applies to every pass (cold and warm). Fork budgets (19 October 2026) were set the same way from the pre-change baseline logs/agent-context-238ldi (build of commit b4f52a56, before the closed-chat release; verifier with the fork workload as committed in 4bab83cc); reasoningReplayed 0 with 4 reasoning deltas sent pins the documented current behaviour. Closed-chat release (19 October 2026): 75 s after closing, at most 5 reply-text strings (the chat history; measured 0 in logs/agent-context-DO8srr, 2-27 before) and at most 14 marker occurrences in all (measured 12, all owned by the bounded prompt-input history, its persisted copy, the chat title, subtitle and Chat History header; 45 before), and reopening the chat restores every prompt and reply. heapMarkerStringsAfterClose stays a non-regression budget (3 s after close, before the release window). CodebaseSearch allowance (20 October 2026): the owner-decided CodebaseSearch tool (OV-502) adds exactly 4,675 schema bytes and 1,302 estimated tokens to every request (logs/agent-context-B0ISB4 against logs/agent-context-DO8srr); each byte and token budget includes exactly that per request (largest request: one schema), nothing else changed; maxToolSchemaBytes pins the 20-tool schema (60,790 bytes per request) so any further tool or schema change needs its own accounting. See docs/performance/agent-context-linux.md.
